verdict.comment: This looks very open. Marginal preference is for REDBRIDGE RAMBLER who should be on a good mark and it's still early days over fences.

comments.janeslittlevoice: In cracking form when last seen but an 11yo now and has been off since October 2023
comments.jessmae: Kept finding for pressure to be 11l off the winner last time at Market Rasen
comments.lockout: C&D winner and capable on his day but can be up and own; not the percentage call
comments.macfin: Multiple point winner; hasn't offered much in two chases following a long absence
comments.puddlesinthepark: Running well until a mid-race unseat last time; should be involved

comments.unspeakable: Off since December but met an improver last time and he's off an untouched mark

comments.jaminska: Her win was in January 2023; second at Exeter (2m2f, good) in November three starts back
comments.pepperqueen: Beat only one home at Ludlow and none at Market Rasen in another bumper

verdict.comment: There's a strong case to be made for last year's winner ASGARD'S CAPTAIN, who is first choice ahead of Midnight Lion.

comments.asgardscaptain: Good effort last time took his C&D record to 211142; won this race last year; respected
comments.beraz: Finished behind two of these rivals on reappearance but may come on for that run
comments.charlieschoice: Record of 5-20 on AW includes three wins this winter; ran creditably last week; in the mix

verdict.comment: A tricky finale can go to ARLINGTON, who wasn't at his best last time but he's a dual C&D winner with a good chance at the weights

comments.arlington: Dual C&D winner last year; below best last time but claims on form of previous C&D run
comments.doontheglen: Yet to win but running respectably of late in handicaps and claims back in this grade
comments.lochaber: Mainly disappointing since sole win last May; easy enough to take on again
comments.magicfluke: Not disgraced in classified events of late but will have to raise game if he's to win this
comments.rockleypoint: Has had a stack of chances since last win; form uneven of late but claims if mood takes
comments.sadiiki: First sign of ability on AW debut after a break last time and may be able to raise game
comments.secretdaay: Longstanding maiden who has a tough task at the weights; opposable
comments.shesashambles: Classified turf winner in August but hasn't added to tally since; decent chance at weights

races.raceComment: arlington is marginally preferred with a score of 52.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over shesashambles. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
